caption: The drawing depicts a grandfather clock shown in two views: a detailed front view on the left and a simplified side profile on the right. The front view shows an ornate clock face with Roman numerals and clock hands, housed in an upper section with decorative scrollwork and finials on top. The body of the clock below the face is vertically elongated, sectioned into three parts with panel detailing in an oval and rectangle shape, and a round panel near the base. The side profile outlines the same tall, narrow structure with the upper decorative finials and crown, a stepped middle, and a rectangular lower section, all aligned vertically. The composition is drawn in thin black lines on tan or beige paper. Above the drawings, there is handwritten text giving details such as "GRANDFATHER'S CLOCK," "WALNUT, INLAID," “MUSEUM OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK," its address, an accession number, and the drawing scale. Additional notes and initials appear near the bottom and the lower right of the drawing. There are two circular marks near the top, likely from hole punches.
title: Grandfather's Clock
